projects.name: Aviya AI Agent
projects.shortDescription: An AI-powered personal career agent that answers recruiter questions about my professional background.
projects.description: A full-stack application that lets recruiters ask questions about my experience and receive focused, relevant answers through an interactive chat interface, backed by a structured personal knowledge base.
highlights: Full-stack architecture with Angular frontend and FastAPI backend
REST API for profile, skills, projects, experience, and chat
Conversational answers as Aviya, with optional Claude integration

projects.name: Compiler Project
projects.shortDescription: A compiler built as part of compiler construction coursework.
projects.description: Implemented core stages of a compiler including lexical analysis, parsing, and code generation, demonstrating understanding of language processing and formal grammars.

projects.name: Reverse Engineering Project
projects.shortDescription: Analysis and reverse engineering of compiled programs.
projects.description: Applied reverse engineering techniques to analyze program behavior, understand binary structure, and demonstrate problem-solving on low-level systems.
